results.title: Stay Forte
results.overview: Tells the incredible true story of Alon Shamiriz, Yotam Haim and Samer Tallaka, three Israelis taken hostage by Hamas during its Oct. 7 attack in southern Israel.

results.title: GEN_
results.overview: At Milan’s Niguarda public hospital, the unconventional Dr. Bini leads a bold mission overseeing aspiring parents undergoing in vitro fertilization and the journeys of individuals reconciling their bodies with their gender identities. He navigates the constraints set by a conservative government and an aggressive market eager to commodify bodies.

results.title: Chaperone
results.overview: Set in rural Hawai’i and featuring an entirely AANHPI cast, Chaperone follows Misha, an unambitious 29-year-old woman who finds a dangerous acceptance in a bright 18-year-old athlete who mistakes her for a fellow high school student.

results.title: Taympers
results.overview: An innocent child Yumi is suddenly introduced to the world of womanhood when she witnesses her older sister Chloe feel pain in her body.

results.title: Bacha Bareesh
results.overview: Bacha Bareesh: Shadows of Innocence is a short documentary film that explores the devastating impact of conflict on the lives of children in Afghanistan. Through intimate storytelling and real-life experiences, the film highlights lost innocence, resilience, and hope amid war and uncertainty.

results.title: The Extraordinary Miss Flower
results.overview: A spellbinding performance film by Iain Forsyth and Jane Pollard, bringing to life the remarkable story the extraordinary Geraldine Flower, and the discovery of a suitcase of letters sent to her in the 1960s and 70s that inspired acclaimed Icelandic singer/songwriter Emilíana Torrini to return to the studio.

results.title: The Voice Left
results.overview: Frustrated journalist Paulo is ensnared by neighbor Marina, waitress and actress. She once seduced him in the elevator, and since then, she never let him go, even though she also never let go of her marriage. Trapped in work, creative block, and Marina's grip, Paulo chooses to cut ties. Drunk, he records a love-hate farewell on a cassette for her. Film depicts his escape attempt and internal battle, shared through recording for the absent Marina.

results.title: Silent Observers
results.overview: With the population in decline, a traditional way of life is ending in a remote, rundown Bulgarian village. This poetic and at times tragicomic film follows the last remaining inhabitants from the perspective of several domesticated animals. There’s a great deal of attention given to sound, light and movement: an overflowing bucket, sunlight dancing in rustling foliage, the ticking sound of ants on the move, and a cowbell clanging in the wind.

results.title: Traces of Love
results.overview: A secret rivalry has existed for years between three close friends: Hande, Cansu, and Eda. The balance is shaken when Hande decides to marry Kerem, who seems like the "perfect man." This is because Kerem has been involved with both Cansu and Eda in the past. This time, the traces of love are about to descend into chaos.

results.title: Niagara Falls
results.overview: Niagara Falls is located on the border between Canada and the USA. While the falls are primarily known for their breathtaking beauty and as a tourist attraction, they also provide a habitat for numerous animal species. However, their conservation poses a major ecological challenge. In the documentary "Niagara Falls – Power of Nature," scientists and naturalists explain the ecosystem of the world-famous Niagara Falls.

results.title: Bogdan Lisevskiy: The Choking Game
results.overview: The first solo stand-up concert where Bogdanchik plays a song from Fight Club on the guitar at the end. And, of course, he also makes funny jokes about parents and all sorts of nonsense.

results.title: A Kill for a Kill
results.overview: A deceptive motivational speaker becomes entangled in a deadly game with a fan who suggests they kill each other's spouses.

results.title: The Chemists
results.overview: In order to be cast in an A-List movie, an undiscovered actor must spend a weekend with his celebrity co-star to build chemistry.

results.title: Headbang
results.overview: The complex power of the hijab, and how a seemingly simple piece of cloth embodies both what the wearer imbues it with and what society project onto to it, through the lens of two different young women.

results.title: I:Scream -A Minty Musical
results.overview: A lovelorn scientist accidentally creates a mutant ice cream scoop that terrorizes their town. Can they stop the minty menace before it eats the object of their affections? A musical sci-fi romp homaging the creature features of the past.

results.title: The Last Camp
results.overview: On December 15, 2024, the collision and sinking of two fuel oil tankers in the Kerch Strait caused one of the most devastating environmental disasters in the history of the Black Sea. Six months later, the tankers lying on the seabed are still leaking fuel oil, and of the thousands of volunteers who initially took part in the cleanup, only a few dozen remain along a 30-kilometer stretch of beach. The film was shot on the Taman Peninsula in early summer 2025, against the backdrop of a formally lifted, yet in reality already underway, beach season. In the face of scarce resources, the departure of their own leaders, and the daily release of fuel oil, the volunteers talk about themselves, rescue animals, combat the ignorance of those around them, and try to find the motivation to continue their fight against a disaster that at times seems endless.

results.title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
results.overview: After a cop’s daughter witnesses a brutal murder, she teams up with an unlikely ally to unravel the mystery before becoming the killer’s next target.

results.title: The Triangle Technique
results.overview: Two losers take their final chance to enchant their crushes from school. They try to achieve this by stealing a secret VHS-tape which gives them a step-by-step tutorial on how to tempt anyone.

results.title: Andrea Bocelli: Because I Believe
results.overview: Over the last 30 years, with a rare repertoire that encompasses pop, rock, and opera, Andrea Bocelli and his golden voice have touched the hearts of millions of listeners around the world. Using last year’s magisterial concert at the Baths of Caracalla as its anchor, Andrea Bocelli: Because I Believe is an intimate portrait of one of the world’s greatest living singers.
